reason: Ivory is a browser-only visual theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness, primarily providing warm-neutral styling, responsive desktop/mobile layouts, accessibility-oriented presentation, and bounded Markdown previews.

summaries.zh: Ivory 是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供暖中性色主题、响应式布局和受限 Markdown 预览的浏览器界面插件。
summaries.en: Ivory is a browser-based DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that provides a warm-neutral theme, responsive layouts, accessibility-oriented styling, and bounded Markdown previews.

capabilities: Applies browser-based visual styling to the DeepSeek Harness interface
Provides responsive light and dark layouts
Stores two user preference flags in localStorage
Renders bounded Markdown previews in the browser
